title: UK ETS aviation regulator-determined emissions and penalty QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: If a compliant verified annual emissions report is not submitted by 31 March, the regulator will determine aviation emissions under the Order.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute a modelled estimate for a regulator determination.

facts.source_fact: The regulator may recover its costs for determining emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep cost recovery separate from emissions quantity.

facts.source_fact: Failure to submit compliant reporting may also lead to a civil penalty.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve enforcement status without assuming a penalty was issued.

facts.source_fact: A regulator-determined emissions figure is recorded in the AOHA after a determination notice.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve determination provenance in registry data.

facts.source_fact: The determined figure is recorded within one month of the notice of determination.
Allowances still must be surrendered by 30 April even if the AOHA figure is missing or disputed.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat registry dispute as surrender exemption.

facts.source_fact: Failure to surrender sufficient allowances by 30 April triggers a mandatory excess-emissions penalty of £100 per tonne CO2 multiplied by the inflation factor.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve statutory rate basis and inflation factor; do not invent a current total.

facts.source_fact: Paying the excess-emissions penalty does not remove the duty to surrender the required allowances.
facts.expected_handling: Keep financial penalty and surrender obligation separate.

facts.source_fact: If an emissions reduction claim is rejected in whole or part, the regulator may determine aviation emissions for the scheme year.
Where a right of appeal exists, the regulator's decision notice sets out the appeal route and information.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer appeal outcome from enforcement status.

guard_patterns.handling: Only label emissions regulator-determined when official determination exists.
Keep determined AOHA values traceable to notice.
Preserve statutory rate formula without inventing inflation-adjusted totals.
Keep penalty, reporting and surrender obligations distinct.
Preserve ERC rejection as a separate determination trigger.
Do not invent emissions, allowances or penalty totals.
Flag enforcement, appeal or registry conflicts.
